description: This file contains unit tests for the AdoNetQueueAdapterReceiver class, specifically testing its behavior against different SQL databases (SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL). It includes setup, message retrieval, confirmation, and shutdown tests, utilizing various external dependencies such as Orleans streaming, SQL utilities, and logging.
